steps: Nyx and Firenze were close school friends. However, Nyx later became an inspector and brought down Firenze's father in a leak case. Firenze joined Darcia to exact her "revenge" on her past friend three years later.
Grind three Forest Elf Fangs to dust, snip two Jade Feathers into pieces…
Then drop them into four ounces of Nightreef Seawater, and give it a good shake...
Whoa! Dad, it turned purple, just like you said it would!
But how? I didn't use anything purple. Did you sneak some magic in there to change the color?
I didn't touch a thing, I promise. It's the magic inside the ingredients. They reacted to create that beautiful hue.
You have a gift for sensing magic, Firenze. Have a little faith. You brewed this potion all by yourself.
Does that mean I can come to the R&D and be your assistant now?
Haha, maybe when you're older. For now, just focus on your studies.
Ugh, studies... By the time I graduate, the Mandrake Radiant Grass will probably be running experiments for you already! You won't even need me.
Don't worry, there's still a long way to go for that project. Even after you finish Philaen Academy and Grace Light Academy, there'll be plenty of work left for you.
I didn't realize even someone as amazing as you had to struggle so much with it... Dad, have you ever thought about quitting?
Hmm... It does get tough sometimes. But I believe this research will bring convenience and happiness to people.
The company and my colleagues have my back, and I have you by my side, don't I?
But enough about me. How's school been lately?
Every day is packed! I made a new friend, Nyx. She's actually really smart. I mean, not as smart as me, of course.
Oh... Firenze. Do you remember what I taught you about friendship?
Never build a friendship on gain, and never, ever betray a friend.
10:30, Nebula Month 16th, Gold District in Philae, United Harvest Company Court
Giotto de Feltro. You stand accused of company treason—leaking confidential data to a witch from Scarlet Sights Media. Do you contest these charges?
He confessed? No way. Why would the Director of R&D sell out to a witch?
Like he had a choice. Officer Nyx is HQ's finest. You saw the evidence—caught him red-handed. Probably wanted the Dorra.
But he's a Director. Would he really turn traitor for a quick payout?
Hey, money is money. De Feltro got sloppy, though. Nyx has only been in Philae for two months, and look at all that has been exposed.
Word is, she's been planning this since the academy. She's best friends with the de Feltro girl. Probably used her to get close to the Director.
It's the daughter's birthday today, too. Putting her father on trial now? Those officers are ruthless.
Shh, keep it down! The girl right in front of us... Isn't that her?
Pfft, who cares? Her father isn't a Director anymore. He's just a convict.
Father gave everything to United Harvest. I don't believe he'd do this! And even he did... He must have had a reason.
Nyx... Why are you the plaintiff? Is the gossip true? Did you befriend me just to get to my father? Was I nothing but a lead to you?
Why? It doesn't make sense... I don't understand...
Your Honor. Director Giotto de Feltro is guilty of embezzlement and the violation of trade secrets.
On behalf of the Compliance Department, I formally submit these charges. We request an immediate ruling.
Defendant Giotto de Feltro. Do you have anything further to add?
No, Your Honor. I betrayed the company. My crimes are unforgivable.
Regarding the leak at the Philae R&D Department: the facts are clear, and the evidence is conclusive. I will now pass sentence.
The court finds you guilty of deliberately stalling the Mandrake Radiant Grass project to misappropriate significant funds and materials. This constitutes the crime of embezzlement...
Furthermore, your unauthorized disclosure of classified data to a Scarlet Sights witch caused the company catastrophic losses. This malicious act constitutes a grave infringement of trade secrets.
For these combined offenses, Giotto de Feltro is sentenced to life imprisonment without possibility of parole or commutation.
L-Life imprisonment? No... How did it come to this...?
In the gallery, a dazed Firenze looks up, locking eyes with her father in the dock.
The spirited man she remembers looks utterly broken. He shakes his head subtly at Firenze before looking away as company guards march him out.
Firenze turns to the plaintiff's stand—empty. Her former best friend, the Inspector, is long gone. Throughout the trial, Nyx's gaze swept the room, yet never once did it land on Firenze.
Why? Why today of all days? I thought we were best friends...
A gentle voice speaks from behind her.
Firenze de Feltro. Don't you see? To Nyx, a "friend" is just an asset to be sold for profit. Actually, what you two had can hardly be called "friendship" at all.
Do you desire the power to overturn this verdict? To clear your father's name?
I am Darcia, Executor of the United Harvest Philae Branch. Stay by my side, and I will grant you the power to crush Nyx.
08:30, Messis Month 23th, Gold District in Philae, Executive Office
What? You're shutting down the Compliance Department of the Philae branch?
No, it's called a merger. Effective today, all local staff and duties of the Compliance Department fall under the Director of Operations. In other words, me.
That makes you my direct report now, Inspector Nyx. You answer to me, not the HQ.
Compliance inspectors answer only to HQ. You don't have the authority!
People change. Rules evolve. This Senate resolution arrived yesterday. Read it.
Resolution on Compliance Department Restructuring... This is impossible.
In the end, you brought this on yourself.
Your blunder during Director Joseph's investigation—accusing an innocent senior tech—made the Senate question the competence of your entire department.
In that case, three of the four witnesses changed their stories in court. The last one even suddenly claimed "amnesia."
They were obviously bought off! How could you just turn a blind eye?
You claim they were bought. Do you have a single shred of proof?
To the Senate, and to me, it looks more like you coerced them. You forced the testimony you needed to secure a conviction.
Just like you did at my father's trial.
I see now... You set me up, Firenze!
All four witnesses were Production staff—your subordinates. This was all a trap you laid just to get revenge, wasn't it?
Fine... Even on my own, I will find the proof. The Senate's resolution didn't revoke an inspector's right to independent investigation.
Suit yourself. But as of today, you belong to Marketing. Those "inspector privileges" won't carry much weight down there...
Knowing you, though... I'm sure you'll claw your way back. Oh, and if the workload proves too much? Resigning is always an option.
Heh... You've somehow become even more twisted than I remember.
I saved this side of myself just for today. It is your birthday, after all. I've waited a long time to give you the ... celebration you deserve.
Three years ago, on your birthday, she took your father to court.
Today, you return the favor on hers—demotion and a pay cut. Tell me, Firenze, is this enough revenge for you?
Of course not, Lady Darcia.==W== This is merely the opening move.
Nyx retains her title. Attacking an inspector openly would draw eyes from HQ,==W== and I wouldn't dare interfere with your plans, My Lady.
You haven't let vengeance cloud your judgment. Good.
Patience is everything. I used false witnesses to force an error, cutting her off from HQ support.
Let her rot in Marketing for now. Once her pride is shattered and she's truly cornered...
Then I'll discard her for good.
When that time comes, she'll be on her knees, weeping, begging me for mercy.
And to think she was once your closest friend.
She was... But she was also the one who betrayed that bond first.
You're right, Lady Darcia.==W== Friends are just assets to be sold. Only power, and you, are worth serving.
Heh... Well said, Firenze. I knew you wouldn't disappoint me.
One day, I'll offer my true loyalty to the master. And you'll destroy United Harvest to save your father.
The master ...==W== Lady Darcia, just who is this master of yours?
00:45, Messis Month 5th, Gold District in Philae, Executive Office
In four years of service, Firenze has never seen Darcia kneel so humbly before anyone. Until now.
But you are Your Majesty. The one true Tyrant. I, Darcia, swear my eternal loyalty to you.
The United Harvest Philae Branch is merely the barracks I built for you. And please consider it your temporary capital.
Cast aside that false name forced upon you. Remember your glory. Lead us, your pitiful subjects, and breathe new life into this devastated world.
Body and soul... All that I am is yours.
The young ==SEX9== being called "Tyrant" looks up, confused.
==PLAYER_NAME==, will you accept this loyalty? Will you take this power, and become the true Tyrant?
